blind.description: A classical ornate stone urn or pedestal basin made of dark charcoal grey stone. It has a stepped circular base, a fluted pedestal stem, and an embellished gadrooned bowl. The flat upper rim is divided into eight segments, each containing a circular recessed socket or inlay ringed in white and black. The interior of the basin is filled to the brim with a flat, pale-grey circular surface resembling water or a polished stone mirror. The mesh is solid, continuous, cleanly modeled, and stands directly on its own molded pedestal base.
blind.from_above: A concentric circular structure featuring a wide pale-grey circular center surrounded by a dark segmented border containing eight small circular ringed sockets evenly spaced around the perimeter.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (just under half the figure's height) and roughly 2.5 to 3 feet wide across the rim.
